brief: Compare renting and buying over a stated horizon without assuming property prices always rise.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Housing Horizon"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Rentar o comprar con horizonte"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Alugar ou comprar com prazo"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare renting and buying over a stated horizon without assuming property prices always rise.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Compare housing over the same stay, including purchase and sale costs; fictional dollars make the assumptions visible.
instruction.misconception: Buying always wins because rent is wasted and a home price always rises.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Compare total costs over the same stay. Buying includes entry, upkeep and exit costs; future resale value is uncertain.
Different periods make the totals incomparable.
Future resale prices are not assured.
Rent costs less under these stated assumptions.
Shorter stays leave fewer months to spread transaction costs.
Timing and the ability to move affect the decision.
The result relies on a resale value that may differ.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
